title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn Crown
moral: Sharing something special makes it even more wonderful.

pages.content: {{NAME}} found a path made of pink stepping stones. He followed them into a meadow full of flowers. The flowers were every colour he knew. In the middle of the meadow stood a white unicorn. It had a crown of flowers on its head.
